card.title: cre — xorr-metropolis/cre (14 Oct, 04:58 UTC)
card.tag: REAL CLI RUN · CRE CLI 1.36 · BROADCAST TO MONAD TESTNET

lines: This is a real run of XORR's workflow with the CRE command line: cre workflow simulate, broadcasting to Monad testnet.
It reads MON from Perpl, Kuru and Chainlink, checks how far apart they are and the gap to Chainlink, and writes one report, with a halt flag, to XorrPriceReceiver.
Here's that report on Monad testnet, through CRE's forwarder into the receiver.

card.title: The council's Price desk gates on it.

lines: The council's Price desk reads this receiver. When the report is stale or halted, the desk vetoes, so nothing trades on a price the workflow didn't vouch for. The workflow isn't deployed on a schedule yet, so runs like this one keep it fresh.

card.title: A council of AI agents trades for you on Monad, and one hold stops it on chain.
